frozen_before: any model run, any QB run and any grader run on these tasks
eligibility: classification.status == 'compatible' against the QB commit actually used for the pilot (re-run qualify.mjs on that commit; today's QB is 784e721)
leak.gold_overlap_lines == 0, OR gold_overlap_cleared is recorded by a reviewer who will not author contracts (the overlap is a screening flag, not proof)
no services and no runtime:node<20 blocker
prior_exposure_arshad is recorded by Arshad (unknown = ineligible; never inferred from public activity) and is not 'contributed' or 'inspected this task' for the repository
sampling: Within each source, order eligible tasks by sha256(seed_sha256 + '|' + task_id), ascending.
Take tasks in that order, skipping a task whose repository is already chosen for that source until every eligible repository in the source has one task (diversity), then continue in order.
Take per_source tasks per source. If a source has fewer, the shortfall is filled round-robin from the other sources in the same hash order, and the shortfall is reported, never hidden.
Never use hard labels, model results, QB results, task size or difficulty in eligibility or order.
if_none_eligible: Return the compatibility report and the adapter proposal (manifest/adapter-analysis.json). Select nothing.
